Site URL: The full web address of the site analyzed.
site_id: A unique reference number for this website in the dataset.
status: Shows whether this website was successfully scanned and included.
domain: The main domain name of the website (for example, 'example.com').
sent_gpc: Shows whether an automated 'Do Not Sell or Share' privacy signal was sent to the site.
gpp_version: The version of the Global Privacy Platform privacy standard found on the site.
uspapi_before_gpc: The site's U.S. state privacy setting before receiving the privacy signal.
uspapi_after_gpc: The site's U.S. state privacy setting after receiving the signal. Checks if the site updated to mark you as opted out.
usp_cookies_before_gpc: The privacy preference cookie saved in the browser before receiving the privacy signal.
usp_cookies_after_gpc: The privacy preference cookie after receiving the signal. Checks if the cookie changed to confirm an opt-out.
OptanonConsent_before_gpc: Cookie banner consent settings managed by OneTrust before receiving the privacy signal.
OptanonConsent_after_gpc: Cookie banner settings after receiving the signal. Checks if the site enabled privacy protections.
gpp_before_gpc: Raw state privacy settings data detected before receiving the privacy signal.
gpp_after_gpc: Raw state privacy settings data detected after receiving the privacy signal.
urlClassification: Types of web trackers and tools detected on the page (such as advertising or social media trackers).
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_before_gpc: Google privacy opt-out status managed by OneTrust before receiving the privacy signal.
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_after_gpc: Google privacy opt-out status managed by OneTrust after receiving the privacy signal.
OTGPPConsent_before_gpc: OneTrust global privacy preference settings before receiving the privacy signal.
OTGPPConsent_after_gpc: OneTrust global privacy preference settings after receiving the privacy signal.
usps_before_gpc: State privacy code before receiving the signal, showing whether your data can be sold.
usps_after_gpc: State privacy code after receiving the signal. Checks if it updated to confirm an opt-out.
decoded_gpp_before_gpc: A readable breakdown of state privacy choices before receiving the privacy signal.
decoded_gpp_after_gpc: A readable breakdown of state privacy choices after receiving the signal, checking for active opt-outs.
USPS implementation: How the site stores state privacy choices (using cookies, page code, or both).
error: Any technical issues encountered while testing the site (such as connection timeouts).
Well-known: Shows if the site publishes an official public file announcing its support for privacy signals.
compliance_result: Overall score showing whether a site honors privacy signals across all checked frameworks (Likely Honors GPC, Likely Does Not Honor GPC, or Not Applicable).
compliance_classification: Full breakdown for each specific framework, GPP section, or field (e.g., USPS, Optanon, or GPP usnat SaleOptOut).
site_isnull: Indicates a site where no privacy strings, cookies, or GPP data were detected before or after sending signals.
reasons_non_compliant: Detailed explanation of specific privacy string violations or missing opt-out signals that caused the site to be evaluated as non-compliant.
Tranco: Website popularity ranking based on web traffic (lower numbers mean higher traffic).
third_party_count: Total count of outside domains or third-party trackers loading on the site.
third_party_urls: List of specific web addresses loaded from outside companies.
unique_ad_networks: Names of advertising networks detected on the website.
num_unique_ad_networks: Total number of distinct advertising networks detected on the page.
